comparison.objective: Tear a loaded shelf-ready tray's front panel off along its perforations without spilling or damaging the tray; the candidate calibrates and locks a gripper stop.
comparison.physical_skill: PR-1834 tests bimanual restraint plus direction-sensitive peeling and progressive fracture; the candidate tests precision threaded adjustment and countertorque with two tools.
comparison.success_condition: PR-1834 requires prescribed perforation separation, retained cans, limited tray motion, release, and stillness; the candidate requires angle accuracy, locked nuts, repeated cycles, and low drift.
comparison.reason: Controlled perforation tearing of packaging is materially different from preserving a mechanical setpoint during jam-nut tightening.
